caption: A handful of dry rice noodles is dropped into hot water, and they go from stiff and brittle to limp and floppy.

sa.check: Dry rice noodles are dropped into the water.
The noodles sink into loose coils.
The noodles are stiff and straight at the start.
The softening starts at the ends in the water.

pc.expect: The noodles go from stiff straight sticks to limp strands that bend, coil and drape over each other.
pc.fail: The noodles stay straight and rigid while fully under the water and glossy; or a noodle snaps into stiff pieces and stays stiff; or the noodles fuse into one solid block; or the noodles stretch like elastic.

pc.expect: The softening only advances and softened noodles do not stiffen again in the hot water.
pc.fail: A limp noodle stiffens and straightens again in the water; or the noodles soften and stiffen in turn; or the noodles are limp before they reach the water; or a coiled noodle springs back straight.

pc.expect: The softening starts where the noodles meet the water and spreads along them, while parts still out of the water stay stiff.
pc.fail: The part standing out of the water goes limp while the submerged part stays stiff; or the whole bundle goes limp at once while only its tips are wetted; or the noodles sit in hot water and stay stiff and straight to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The softened noodles sink or settle into the water and the bundle sags downward as it gives way.
pc.fail: A noodle rises out of the water and hangs above it; or a noodle hangs motionless in mid-water; or the bundle stands upright in the water with nothing holding it; or the noodles float on top like a raft and stay dry.

pc.expect: The noodles that go in are the noodles in the water and none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A noodle vanishes; or new noodles appear with none added; or two noodles merge into one thicker strand; or a noodle passes through the pot's wall.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pot, the water and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pot changes colour; or the water turns a colour; or items around the pot rearrange.
